title: Generated tool schemas versus core Pydantic validation
description: Pydantic AI generates a JSON Schema from a tool function's type hints and docstring, using core Pydantic BaseModel validation under the hood.

steps.description: Wrapping days_until in Tool(days_until) builds a JSON Schema directly from the target: date annotation and the Args docstring entry.
DaysUntilArgs is a plain Pydantic BaseModel with no agent involved; it declares the same target: date field and description.
model_validate parses '2026-12-07' into a Python date object and raises ValidationError on 'next Tuesday'.
